research.sampling_rule: Adobe Stock 公开页遇 DataDome 403 立即停止抓取，站内原生样本为 0、覆盖率不可计算。补充公开商用图库（Vecteezy/Dreamstime/Shutterstock/iStock/Magnific）按 5 类 15 组宽词与用途词检索，每类预先计划抽取 5 张公开缩略图（共 25 张）优先核对宽词靠前结果与查重邻近样本，遇 403/429 即停；未抽样卡片全部标为「仅标题或元数据」。

adobe_stock_native.block_reason: https://stock.adobe.com/my/illustrations 与 Artist Hub 返回 HTTP/2 403 (x-datadome: protected)，按规则立即停止访问。

supplementary_public_stock.unattempted_reason: 按每类 5 张预设抽样限额控制规模，其余 106 条标为「仅标题或元数据」。

history_check.research_page_status: 无法访问（https://chatgpt.com/space/page_ef5e74d873dc81919960f0769ca7f9c3 需登录或受限，已于本轮报告输出完整补录文本）。

research.scoring_note: 严格遵循任务所列 7 项细分满分（25+20+10+15+10+10+5=95），未人为拔高分项，topic_score 为 7 项真实之和；因 Adobe Stock 原生页面受阻，需求证据分保守封顶于 18/20。
research.limitations: 1) stock.adobe.com/my/illustrations、Artist Hub 与站内搜索页均触发 DataDome HTTP 403 防护，本轮未抓取到 Adobe Stock 原生素材卡，所有词条的 Adobe Stock 站内供给记为未知；2) 研究页 chatgpt.com/space 无法直接读取与写回，无法核对历史排除清单中未同步至 GitHub 的条目；3) 补充图库 25 张视觉核对仅能说明所看样本的构图、嵌字误匹配与同质化特征，无法代表所有未检视结果，且无法仅凭缩略图确认原图四边精确无缝或真实透明通道。

assets.theme: Seamless Garden Rose and Rosebud Sprig Pattern on Warm Linen
assets.palette: dusty rose, warm blush, muted sage, ivory linen, soft taupe
assets.prompt: Design a 4K horizontal 16:9 standalone seamless repeating floral pattern for gift wrapping paper, cotton fabric printing, and boutique stationery covers. Depict newly composed garden rose blossoms, half-opened rosebuds, slender stems, and serrated sage leaves arranged in a balanced organic half-drop rhythm across a warm ivory textured linen paper ground. Vary floral scale from open focal blooms to delicate trailing buds with generous breathing room between motifs so the pattern tiles smoothly on all four edges with zero visible seams or rigid grid repetition. Paint in refined hand-painted matte gouache with subtle dry-brush petal shading, delicate botanical veining, and tactile paper grain. Illuminate evenly with soft diffuse daylight for a calm, timeless romantic mood and consistent print luminance across the entire repeat. Deliver an opaque raster surface pattern with no text, logos, watermarks, mockups, borders, or drop shadows.
assets.negative_prompt: text, typography, letters, logos, watermarks, mockups, visible tile seams, harsh grid lines, neon colors, flat ditsy four-petal clipart, dark red heavy outlines, transparent background, checkerboard, picture frames

assets.theme: Seamless Mediterranean Fig Branch and Blossom Block Print Pattern
assets.palette: muted terracotta, olive green, warm cream, plum brown
assets.prompt: Create a 4K horizontal 16:9 standalone seamless botanical surface pattern tailored for kitchen textiles, artisan food packaging, and cookbook endpapers. Feature hand-carved Mediterranean fig branches bearing whole ripe figs, deeply lobed leaves, and clusters of tiny pale blossoms distributed evenly across an unbleached warm cream cotton ground. Organize the motifs in a rhythmic diagonal repeat with carefully balanced negative space so opposite horizontal and vertical borders connect seamlessly without banding or crowding. Execute in an authentic three-color linocut block print aesthetic using muted olive green, earthy terracotta, and soft plum-brown inks, revealing subtle carved gouge edges and delicate hand-pressed ink grain. Keep illumination flat, neutral, and uniform to preserve true print flatness and consistent tonal contrast for commercial production. Produce an opaque raster textile pattern completely free of sliced neon fruit clichés, text, logos, watermarks, mockups, or decorative borders.
assets.negative_prompt: text, logos, watermarks, mockups, visible seams, tropical monstera leaves, bright neon pink sliced figs, glossy 3D plastic fruit, photographic glare, frames, transparent background, checkerboard

assets.theme: Seamless Pressed Clay Octagonal Star Tile Pattern in Sage and Cream
assets.palette: muted sage green, warm alabaster cream, soft stone grout, pale ochre
assets.prompt: Render a 4K horizontal 16:9 standalone seamless geometric tile surface pattern designed for Ramadan and Eid 2027 gift box sleeves, luxury tea packaging, and heritage editorial backgrounds. Compose interlocking eight-pointed geometric stars and cross-shaped tiles crafted from matte pressed ceramic clay in muted sage green and warm alabaster cream, separated by fine light stone grout lines. Arrange the tessellation at a crisp orthogonal top-down scale with continuous edge-to-edge symmetry so all four sides repeat seamlessly without visual breaks or center medallion lock-in. Emphasize subtle tactile glaze variation, gently beveled tile shoulders, and restrained artisanal surface speckles inspired by handcrafted glazed earthenware. Cast soft directional raking studio light from the upper left to reveal gentle low-relief depth while keeping overall luminance calm and even enough for overlaid typography. Output an opaque raster texture with zero calligraphy, text, badges, logos, watermarks, or harsh reflections.
assets.negative_prompt: text, Arabic calligraphy, Eid Mubarak lettering, center medallion badge, logos, watermarks, mockups, glossy plastic reflections, broken tiles, uneven perspective, visible repeat seams, neon green, transparent background

assets.theme: Seamless Art Deco Scalloped Fan Relief Pattern on Matte Charcoal
assets.palette: deep charcoal slate, brushed antique champagne gold, warm graphite
assets.prompt: Create a 4K horizontal 16:9 standalone seamless Art Deco geometric surface background built for luxury packaging, gala event invitations, and executive presentation covers. Arrange layered scalloped fan arches with restrained radial ribbing across a deep matte charcoal cotton-paper surface, pairing subtle blind-debossed grooves with fine brushed antique champagne-gold line inlays. Keep the geometric repeat well-proportioned and moderate in density so every four-sided edge joins seamlessly and fine details stay crisp when scaled down for print labels or digital banners. Model authentic paper fiber grain and tactile micro-embossing rather than glossy digital gradients or flashy chrome highlights. Illuminate with calm oblique studio light that gently catches the matte metallic ridges while maintaining a quiet, refined dark mood suitable for light overlaid headlines. Deliver an opaque raster pattern completely free of text, monograms, logos, watermarks, or framed mockup edges.
assets.negative_prompt: text, letters, monograms, logos, watermarks, mockups, bright yellow chrome glare, lens flare, glitter sparkles, crowded hairline maze, white background, visible tile seams, transparent background

Leave the entire interior of the arch and outer safety margins open as an uncluttered, gently textured warm oatmeal cotton-paper surface ready for centered event headlines, schedules, or vertical story typography. Illustrate in refined naturalist watercolor and colored pencil with realistic petal translucency, fine stem overlap, and organic matte paper fibers. Illuminate evenly with soft, diffused natural daylight for a serene, welcoming editorial mood with balanced tonal contrast. Deliver one opaque raster composition containing no placeholder text, gold foil clipart lines, card mockups, logos, or watermarks.

assets.theme: Seamless Wild Rosehip, Ribbon Bow, and Tiny Heart Sprig Wrap Pattern
assets.palette: burgundy berry red, dusty rose ribbon, muted moss green, warm cream cotton
assets.prompt: Design a 4K horizontal 16:9 standalone seamless gift wrap pattern tailored for Valentine's Day 2027 packaging, patisserie gift boxes, and year-round romantic stationery. Interweave slender wild rosehip twigs with burgundy berries, loosely tied dusty-rose velvet ribbon bows, and sparse tiny hand-painted hearts across a warm cream matte cotton-paper ground. Distribute elements in a gentle multi-directional repeat with ample open cream spacing so all four edges tile cleanly without seams, clustering, or rigid rows. Paint in charming editorial gouache with crisp botanical brushwork, soft fabric ribbon folds, and delicate paper tooth, elevating the palette into refined berry and blush tones that remain reusable beyond February for Mother's Day and wedding favors. Light evenly with soft neutral daylight for clean print reproduction and warm tactile charm. Deliver an opaque raster pattern free of lettering, neon hearts, cartoon doodles, logos, watermarks, or wrapping mockups.
assets.negative_prompt: text, love typography, neon pink cartoon hearts, crowded doodle hearts, stark black outline grid, felt heart garland, logos, watermarks, gift box mockups, visible tile seams, transparent background
